title: Earkick
summary:
Earkick is a mental health app powered by AI, designed to help users track and improve their mental well-being in real time. It is developed by a Swiss-American startup founded in 2021 by Herbert, a computer vision expert who has built and sold computer vision and AI startups, and Karin, whose thesis on the intersection of mental health and technology laid the foundation for the app's mission. The company operates out of the US and Switzerland.

The app features a friendly AI companion called Panda, which offers immediate support. Earkick does not require registration, meaning no account, login, or personal identifiers are needed. All interactions are encrypted using AES-256. The app's guidance engine is rooted in clinically validated approaches like Cognitive Behavioral Therapy (CBT) and Dialectical Behavior Therapy (DBT).

Features include smart check-ins, progress statistics, breathing and CBT exercises, a panic button, soundscapes, a habit tracker, a knowledge hub, and an Apple Watch app. With over 250,000 users and an average 4.8-star rating in app stores, the app has been featured by Apple, National Geographic, TIME, Forbes Health, Vogue, BBC, and The Guardian.

Earkick represents part of a growing trend in AI-powered mental health tools that prioritize privacy and accessibility. The app uses a multi-modal large language model companion to provide support while ensuring that users can engage in vulnerable emotional conversations without concerns about data being stored, sold, or misused.
